g11_note: Reviewer sensitivity to transition-heavy receipts being extrapolated indefinitely. Remove half the G11 profile from 2040, keep earlier years and GX unchanged. Not a legal-loss forecast, empirical estimate or jointly rescored tax package.
margin_note: Reviewer illustration, not a new D4 rule or an identified tax. Minimum financing plus 0.1% GDP at maturity; no probability attached. Receipt ramp 2030-34.
service_space_note: Unallocated expenditure envelope reaching 0.1% GDP in 2034 for participation, delivery remedies and resilience; NOT a cost estimate or authority to spend. No care entitlement, new housing capital or grid package is included.

climate.note: Weak grid delivery combines low transmission/reconductoring parameters from existing model ranges with half the default curtailment benefit. Expensive grid doubles the model's assumed $12B/year cost only. No probability or empirical program score. These cases do not estimate engineering feasibility. Credits-off is a diagnostic removal of the model credit bundle, not a proposed repeal or exact CLI-1 budget swap.
